sharedPrompt: Create one premium editorial feature image for MyBreakeven.com, a finance and educational calculator website. Wide landscape 16:9 composition, high-end tactile 3D editorial illustration with subtle realistic material textures and soft studio lighting, ivory and pale lavender backdrop, deep navy, violet and restrained teal accents. Strong distinct central subject and intentional negative space, excellent clarity as a small card thumbnail. This is conceptual cover art, NOT a quantitative diagram or app screenshot. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, charts with meaningful values, currency symbols or promises. Avoid generic floating neon icons, clutter and cartoon people. Subject:
